items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: I never worked with them in the Amos. I never worked with them in the Amos. No.

ctx.x: They were doing the same thing we were doing, trying to sell their numbers, and they were singing. Did you ever work with them in that sense? No, I never worked with them in the Amos. I never worked with them in the Amos. No. Who did they work with? I guess they had their own groups, you know. Their own groups? Yeah, they didn't. In other words, they didn't join groups that you were with. No, no, no.
